observation: Read-only WASM observation ABI; actual exported projectScrollTree pure utility plus DOM scrollbar positions
limits: No runtime/game/payload/renderer or developer API mutations and no direct materialization calls.
Portrait is tested with a mouse at a narrow viewport; this is not a mobile touch-device test.
This probe is one SDK-authored project, not a general guarantee for all layouts.

visualReview.method: Direct visual inspection of actual desktop-final.png and portrait-final.png screenshots
visualReview.scope: This is a project-authored fixed-geometry layout limitation; the interaction test does not establish automatic layout or typography fitting.

portrait.finding: At 390x844 the fixed two-column project layout clips headings, subtitle, counts, combobox label, list row labels and loaded-key label. Mouse hitboxes and all tested state transitions work, but this does not pass visual responsive-layout QA.

desktop.finding: Headings, control labels, counts and selected row are readable at 1440x900.

okScope: Interaction and runtime checks only; visualReview explicitly records portrait clipping.
